summary: The Transilvania STEPS International Contemporary Dance Festival will take place in Cluj-Napoca from November 6 to 8. Singapore’s Decadance Co will open the festival on November 6 with The 11th Hour, featuring two works choreographed by Rachel Lum and Sam Coren. The production uses satire, absurdity, and dark humor to explore death, loss, and the stories people use to make sense of the unknown, the organizers said.
